1.web: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
1.asv: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth’s sake.

2.web: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
2.asv: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?

3.web: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
3.asv: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.

4.web: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
4.asv: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.

5.web: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.
5.asv: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

6.web: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
6.asv: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;

7.web: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
7.asv: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.

8.web: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
8.asv: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

9.web: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
9.asv: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

10.web: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
10.asv: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

11.web: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
11.asv: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

12.web: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
12.asv: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless us: He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

13.web: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
13.asv: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.

14.web: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.
14.asv: Jehovah increase you more and more, You and your children.

15.web: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
15.asv: Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

16.web: The heavens are the heavens of Yahweh; but the earth has he given to the children of men.
16.asv: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.

17.web: The dead don’t praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;
17.asv: The dead praise not Jehovah, Neither any that go down into silence;

18.web: But we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!
18.asv: But we will bless Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Praise ye Jehovah.
